title: IT Specialist - Network
description:
**It's more than a job**
 In this IT role, you will manage, develop, and support the technology infrastructure that powers Kuehne\+Nagel’s global systems and operations. This contribution is vital to making both special and ordinary moments in the lives of people a reality. In fact, your work enables our teams to deliver fresh fruit, time\-sensitive healthcare products and much more to people all around the world. Working in IT at Kuehne\+Nagel contributes to more than we imagine.
   

  

 ‎
   

  

 The Person is responsible for providing a stable, reliable and secure IT network environment.
   

  

 To be the technical expert and project leader of medium to large projects related to Network (Active \& Passive).
   

  

 To explore, recommend and adopt new technologies to benefit the organization.
   

  

 Ensures that infrastructure tasks required for a successful implementation of projects take place. This includes the implementation of a solution design which has been developed by Global IT Team.
   

  

**How you create impact**
* Understand the business requirements and design the complete network infrastructure (both Active \& Passive) himself
* Basis the high\-level requirements, do the Heatmapping for wireless network with zero blind spots.
* Establish pro\-active monitoring mechanisms on servers and network, monitor performance bottlenecks, e.g. hardware / bandwidth resources and to lead discussions with regional IT team or external vendors for solutions.
* Coordinate with 3rd Party vendors to define the scope of work.
* Monitor and Manage the IT service provider to ensure that agreed service levels are reached.
* Documentation of Infrastructure design, network layout and IT Asset inventory (pre \& post) stages of the projects.
* Responsible for the successful implementation of the project, that includes management of resources, deadlines, budget and agreed deliverables.
* Ensure quality of implemented IT infrastructure and compliance as per company policies.
* Analyze and identify project risks and perform permanent risk management including timely communication to the relevant stakeholder.
* Upskill the other team members on the best practices


**What we would like you to bring**
* 4–8 years of experience in Network Infrastructure roles.
* Hands\-on experience with Cisco, HP, Aruba, and/or Extreme networking solutions.
* Strong knowledge of Wi\-Fi, Access Points, Switches, Routers, and SD\-WAN.
* Experience in network design, implementation, and support.
* Proven track record in office, retail, or warehouse network setup projects.
* Ability to perform wireless site surveys and heat mapping.
* Experience managing vendors and coordinating project delivery.
* Knowledge of network monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Minimum two networking certifications (CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent).
* Strong communication skills and ability to work independently.


**What's in it for you**
* Global Exposure: Step into a world of international opportunities with a presence in 100\+ countries.
* People\-Centric Culture: Join a team where your voice matters and people genuinely care.
* Learning \& Development: Grow with us personally and professionally through world\-class training and career pathways.
* Innovation \& Sustainability: Be part of a future\-focused company driving real change in logistics and the planet.
* Rewards \& Recognition: Get rewarded for your passion, performance, and potential.
* Stability with Agility: Enjoy the best of both worlds a trusted global brand with a startup spirit.


**Who we are**
 Logistics shapes everyday life \- from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne\+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
   

  

 As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life\-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

title: Network Performance Consultant
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 Join our dynamic team at Ericsson as a Solution Architect. In this pivotal role, we want tech enthusiasts who are genuinely passionate about delivering cutting\-edge solutions to global customers. If you're detail\-oriented, thrive in fast\-paced environments, and love putting customers first—this could be your next move. Soft skills matter just as much as technical chops here. You'll collaborate with diverse stakeholders across the organization, so being a strong communicator and team player is key.
   

  

**What You'll Do:**
 As an Packet Core Performance Consultant, you'll dive deep into customer challenges and ambitions, leverage your expertise in Ericsson's portfolio (and third\-party products), and craft end\-to\-end strategies that optimize network performance and customer experience.
   

  

**Your mission:**
 Deliver innovative, cost\-effective solutions that create real business value. You'll need to adapt quickly to change and show leadership across both Ericsson and customer teams.
   

  

**The Impact:**
 You'll be at the center of major network transformation projects for Ericsson's biggest customers. This means collaborating closely with Product Units, Customer teams, Technical groups, and Marketing/Business Development.
   

  

 You'll design and deploy solutions that enhance network capacity, functionality, and end\-user services—working across IMS and Packet Core portfolios with a focus on leading the charge into 5G Core and in the E2E chain.
   

  

**Why This Role Rocks:**
* Work on next\-gen 5G technology and beyond
* Global customer exposure
* Drive real transformation project
* Shape innovative solutions from the ground up


**Join our Team**
****What will you bring:****
**People \& Communication**
* Customer relationship pro who can build trust and drive conversations
* Craft and deliver compelling technical presentations and proposals
* Strong consultative mindset—you see the forest and the trees
* Bridge the gap between engineers, developers, and sales teams


**Mindset \& Approach**
* Innovative, creative spirit with a healthy appetite for risk\-taking
* Strategic thinker who can pivot to tactical execution when needed
* Thrive under pressure and tight deadlines
* Open to traveling (25%\+)


**Technical Chops**
* Solid experience delivering end\-to\-end solutions in domains like Packet Core, TCP Optimization and Routing.
* Expert\-level knowledge in some of the following Core Network Functions: AMF, SMF, MME, SGW/PGW\-C/U, UPF, DNS
* Deep understanding of 4G/5G mobile networks, E2E optimization, and network design
* Strong grasp of 3GPP standards—and how to apply them in real\-world implementations


**Networking \& Protocols**
* Signaling\-Plane and User\-Plane analysis (familiar with major monitoring systems and Wireshark)
* TCP/QUIC protocol knowledge
* Routing and switching expertise


**Data \& Analysis**
* Data analytics skills: Python (Pandas, NumPy, Parquet, etc), MySQL, Excel, Tableau
* Comfortable translating data into actionable insights


**Collaboration \& Growth**
* Work closely with R\&D—provide feedback and spark new ideas
* Stay current on emerging tech and share knowledge to build customer competence
* Active participant in knowledge transfer and documentation


**Preferred Skills:**
* Experience defining new business models
* Design Thinking knowledge and rapid prototyping experience
* Hands\-on experience building cloud infrastructure and NFV (Network Function Virtualization)
* 5\+ years in technology leadership roles
* Background in system testing \& troubleshooting
* Knowledge Cloud \& Virtualization,
* Knowledge of virtualization techniques
* Routing and Switching Certifications (Ericsson or Cisco)
* AI/ML \& Automation: Familiarity with AIOps, machine learning for network optimization, and intelligent automation tools
* Python/Scripting: Programming skills for automation and data analysis
* Cloud\-Native Expertise: Experience with multi\-cloud environments, microservices, and cloud\-native network functions (CNF)
* Emerging Tech: Knowledge of network slicing, edge computing, and intent\-based networking
* Security Forward: Understanding of Zero Trust architectures and modern security frameworks
* Continuous Learner: Demonstrated ability to quickly adopt new technologies and methodologies

title: Enterprise Network & Service Management Architect
description:
**About Us**
 Join us at Orange Business!
   

  

 We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
   

  

 Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
   

  

**Role Description**
**About the role**
 The Enterprise Network Solution Architect is responsible for aiding and supporting on\-shore Sales and Presales teams in Asia Pacific by designing, positioning and selling Orange Network, and Security solutions and its portfolio, as well as assisting in providing product/service and commercial overviews of Orange network service offerings.
   

  

 This role requires an Architect that has a combined technical design \& implementation background with the focus on designing and positioning solutions based on customer’s business requirements involving advanced networks, data centre and security technologies thereby supporting onshore presales teams through conference calls and other remote collaboration means. The Network Solution Architect shall be supporting the development and answering solution designs, technical descriptions for RFI’s \& RFP’s, drafting cost sheets and assists in closing deals with the Account Managers and Presales.
   

  

**Key responsibilities are as follows:**
* Design enterprise network Solution Architecture encompassing technologies such as Network (MPLS, SD\-WAN, SD\-LAN, Cloud or cloud security) ensuring that it meets the customers business requirements and performance goals.
* Partner with Asia Pacific Onshore presales as required in qualifying opportunities, delivering demonstrations, and providing security consulting expertise.
* Provide design support of enterprise networking solutions for both new and existing customers (managed or integrated) in support of increasing sales including:
* Actively support responses to proposals, RFQ, RFP and RFI requirements
* Prepare high quality technical deliverables such as High\-Level Design, Low Level Design, technical proposal, Bill of Materials etc.
* Prepare cost estimates for all network and associated infra. solutions
* Identify \& remediate potential integration issues
* Lead solution demo \& pilots to support onshore solution team
* Lead the architecture discussions to work through risk, security, capacity and performance concerns.
* Lead customer facing activities including customer proposals, workshops and presentations.
* Interlock with nearshore and offshore teams to fully understand latest advancements in enterprise networking technology, different operating models and value proposition
* As a SME, he/she will be accountable to lead and make decisions on all aspects of enterprise networking and/or security proposal design and integration with client ecosystems
* Attend training sessions, both in\-house, vendor specific and external to broaden and master your skillset into advanced and emerging areas of enterprise networking such as SD WAN, SDLAN, SDA, NDR, Network segmentation etc.
* An ideal candidate would be an ambitious and intuitive individual, with strong skills in Network technologies and very good understanding of next gen security and or multi\-cloud solutions, who can work under their own direction towards agreed targets/goals and with creative approach and managing time and change effectively


**About You**
**Experience Required**
* A minimum of 10 years’ experience in
* architecting, deploying and/or managing large\-scale, high performing and resilient networking solutions and within either a 24x7 datacentre environment or global enterprise
* Designing, implementing, and/or supporting solutions involving, but not limited to WAN (MPLS, SD\-WAN), LAN,WLAN, and software designed technologies like SDN, NFV, SASE, cloud or network security technologies required
* A minimum of 3 years’ experience in designing and/or implementing MPLS networks, with exposure on SD\-WAN technologies and security or public cloud solutions will be an added advantage. Experience on product from Cisco Viptela, Silverpeak or Velo cloud for SD WAN solutions
* Deep expertise, understanding and knowledge of Infrastructure Network and Security, SD WAN, Routing and Switching, Firewalls, Load Balancers, Cloud Networking and Cyber Security
* Experience in designing and/or implementing WAN Physical Connectivity for Large global MPLS/SD\-WAN Projects shall be preferred
* Robust understanding \& cloud networking experience with AWS, Azure or GCP is required.
* Professional certifications such as CCNP, CCIE RS or equivalent are preferred
* Experience in writing proposals and scopes, responding to tenders/RFQ/RFP/RFI
* Good communication skills, both written and verbal
* Strong understanding of and ability to speak to networking principles in areas of emerging technology


**Key Contacts/Relationships**
* Members of staff within the Onshore APAC Sales team
* Global Pre\-Sales \& Professional services team
* Members of staff within the Digital Innovation \& Design team
* Digital Innovation \& Design team Manager


**Level of Education**

**Key Responsibilities**
* Strategic Architecture \& Design
+ Develop comprehensive enterprise SDA architecture strategies aligned with business objectives, security requirements, and organizational growth
+ Design end\-to\-end Software\-Defined Access solutions spanning campus, branch, and remote access environments
+ Architect multi\-site SDA fabrics incorporating fabric edge, fabric core, and border nodes
+ Design network segmentation and microsegmentation strategies using SDA's policy\-based approach
+ Create detailed architectural documentation, design specifications, and reference architectures
+ Conduct feasibility studies and provide recommendations for network modernization initiatives
+ Develop network migration strategies and roadmaps for legacy infrastructure to SDA
+ Design solutions supporting diverse environments (wired, wireless, branch, IoT, guest)

* SDA Implementation Leadership
+ Lead the design and implementation of enterprise\-scale SDA deployments across multiple sites
+ Architect Catalyst Center integration with SDA fabric management and provisioning
+ Design fabric topology including fabric edge, fabric core, border nodes, and control plane nodes
+ Architect IP address management (IPAM) and DHCP strategies for SDA environments
+ Design and implement SDA policy frameworks and scalable group tags (SGTs)
+ Lead integration of wireless networks (Catalyst 9000 series) with SDA fabric
+ Architect branch connectivity using SD\-WAN integration with SDA
+ Design and implement SDA for IoT, guest, and BYOD access scenarios

* Zero\-Trust Security Architecture
+ Architect comprehensive zero\-trust security frameworks leveraging SDA capabilities
+ Design identity\-based and device\-based access policies using Cisco ISE integration
+ Architect microsegmentation strategies using Scalable Group Tags (SGTs) and Security Group ACLs (SGACLs)
+ Design threat\-centric access control policies based on user, device, and application context
+ Architect integration with Cisco Secure Network Analytics (Stealthwatch) for threat detection
+ Design encryption and authentication strategies for SDA environments
+ Develop compliance frameworks aligned with industry standards (PCI\-DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, etc.)
+ Design audit and logging architectures for compliance and forensic analysis

* Network Segmentation \& Policy Architecture
+ Design scalable network segmentation using Scalable Group Tags (SGTs)
+ Architect Security Group ACLs (SGACLs) for granular access control
+ Design policy\-based access control frameworks translating business requirements into network policies
+ Architect VN (Virtual Network) designs for multi\-tenancy and organizational separation
+ Design and implement advanced policy features including contract\-based policies
+ Architect policy analytics and visibility for compliance and security monitoring
+ Design policy governance and change management processes

* Catalyst Center \& Automation Architecture
+ Architect Catalyst Center integration with SDA fabric management and provisioning
+ Design network automation and orchestration strategies leveraging Catalyst Center APIs
+ Develop Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) strategies for SDA configuration management
+ Design REST API integration strategies with third\-party applications and orchestration platforms
+ Architect monitoring, assurance, and analytics policies using Catalyst Center capabilities
+ Design and implement advanced automation workflows for SDA operations
+ Architect integration with ITSM and IPAM platforms

* Wireless \& Access Architecture
+ Design enterprise wireless architectures integrated with SDA fabric
+ Architect Catalyst 9000 series access points and controllers for SDA environments
+ Design wireless segmentation and policy enforcement strategies
+ Architect guest access, BYOD, and IoT connectivity within SDA framework
+ Design roaming and mobility strategies for wireless devices
+ Architect wireless security policies and encryption strategies
+ Design wireless assurance and performance monitoring

* Branch \& Remote Access Architecture
+ Design SD\-WAN integration with SDA for branch connectivity
+ Architect branch fabric edge nodes and connectivity strategies
+ Design secure remote access solutions (VPN, zero\-trust remote access)
+ Architect branch segmentation and policy enforcement
+ Design failover and redundancy strategies for branch connectivity
+ Architect branch assurance and performance monitoring
+ Design solutions for remote workers and distributed workforces

* Data Center \& Cloud Integration
+ Design SDA solutions for data center and cloud integration scenarios
+ Architect connectivity between SDA fabric and data center networks (ACI, traditional)
+ Design hybrid cloud networking strategies leveraging SDA
+ Architect cloud\-based identity and access management integration
+ Design solutions supporting containerized environments and Kubernetes
+ Architect multi\-cloud connectivity and policy enforcement

* Leadership \& Strategic Influence
+ Mentor senior network engineers and architects on SDA best practices and advanced concepts
+ Lead architectural review boards and design governance processes
+ Contribute to industry thought leadership through presentations, whitepapers, and technical publications
+ Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend adoption strategies
+ Establish network architecture standards and best practices across the organization
+ Participate in vendor relationships and influence product roadmap discussions
+ Drive continuous improvement and innovation in network architecture practices
+ Build and maintain relationships with Cisco technical teams and partners

+ Present architectural recommendations and technical findings to executive leadership
+ Translate business requirements and security mandates into technical architecture
+ Collaborate with security, infrastructure, application, and cloud teams
+ Manage architectural reviews and provide technical guidance on design decisions
+ Communicate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences
+ Participate in strategic planning and IT governance processes
+ Conduct training and knowledge transfer sessions on SDA technologies

title: Principal Engineer
description:
**Business Unit:**
 Data Strategy Group
   

  

**Industry:**
 No Industry
   

  

**Overview**
 Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data\-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com.
   

  

**Scope**
 We are seeking a highly accomplished
 **Principal Engineer** 
 to serve as the technical authority and architectural leader for our cloud\-native platform and infrastructure within the Financial Platform organization. In this role, you will define the platform architecture roadmap, design mission\-critical infrastructure patterns, and lead the technical execution of platforms that power large\-scale, distributed financial applications.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Platform Architecture \& Strategic Direction: Define and drive the target\-state architecture for our next\-generation, cloud\-native platform (Kubernetes, multi\-region cloud topologies, and AI/workload enablement). Translate overarching business goals into scalable, resilient, and decoupled platform capabilities.
* Hands\-On Core Engineering: Lead by example by writing production\-grade code, building foundational custom tooling/operators (Golang, Python), authoring reusable Terraform modules, and designing reference implementations for engineering teams.
* Technical Leadership \& Mentorship: Serve as a mentor and technical coach to junior and mid\-level engineers. Facilitate design reviews, establish architecture RFC processes, conduct deep code/infrastructure reviews, and foster a strong culture of engineering excellence.

title: RF communication Sr. Engineer
description:
Key Responsibilities
 
**1\. RF Communication System Design** 



* Design RF communication architecture for UAVs and Ground Control Stations.
* Develop long\-range command, control, telemetry and payload data links.
* Select RF transceivers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, connectors and other RF components.
* Work on communication links for different UAV ranges and operating environments.
* Perform RF link\-budget calculations and system\-level RF analysis.



**2\. FHSS / Secure Communication** 



* Design and integrate
 **Frequency Hopping Spread Spectrum (FHSS)** 
 communication systems.
* Develop frequency\-hopping schemes and synchronization mechanisms.
* Work on secure and encrypted communication links.
* Experience with
 **AES\-128/AES\-256 or equivalent encryption** 
 is desirable.
* Understand techniques for improving communication reliability in congested and contested RF environments.



**3\. SDR Development** 



* Work with
 **Software Defined Radio (SDR)** 
 platforms.
* Develop and test SDR\-based communication systems.
* Hands\-on experience with platforms such as
 **USRP, ADALM\-Pluto, HackRF, LimeSDR or equivalent** 
 is preferred.
* Experience with GNU Radio, MATLAB/Simulink or similar tools.
* Develop/modify PHY and communication protocols where required.



**4\. Long\-Range UAV Communication** 



* Develop communication links with
 **10–50\+ km range** 
 , depending on application.
* Optimize communication systems for UAV altitude, antenna position, terrain and operating environment.
* Work on high\-reliability telemetry and command links.
* Experience with 900 MHz, 1\.2 GHz, 2\.4 GHz, 5\.8 GHz or other suitable RF bands is desirable.



**5\. Mesh \& Swarm Communication** 



* Design and integrate
 **mesh/networked communication** 
 between multiple UAVs.
* Work on UAV\-to\-UAV and UAV\-to\-GCS communication.
* Understand dynamic routing, network topology and self\-healing networks.
* Experience with
 **swarm communication and multi\-UAV networking** 
 will be a major advantage.



**6\. Anti\-Jamming / EW Awareness** 



* Understand RF interference, jamming, spoofing and spectrum congestion.
* Develop communication systems with improved resistance to interference.
* Work on frequency agility, adaptive channel selection and link\-quality monitoring.
* Experience with
 **EW\-resistant communication systems, spectrum sensing or anti\-jamming techniques** 
 is highly desirable.



**7\. Antenna \& RF Hardware** 



* Select and integrate omnidirectional and directional antennas for UAVs.
* Understand antenna gain, VSWR, impedance matching, polarization and radiation patterns.
* Work with RF cables, connectors, filters, LNAs, PAs and RF switches.
* Perform antenna placement and RF coexistence analysis on drones.



**8\. Drone System Integration** 



* Integrate RF communication systems with:
* Flight Controller
* Companion Computer
* GCS
* Payloads
* EO/IR cameras
* Telemetry systems
* Navigation systems
* Interface RF modules through UART, SPI, Ethernet, CAN, USB and other interfaces.
* Work closely with Embedded, Flight Control and Drone System Engineering teams.



**9\. Testing \& Validation** 



* Conduct RF range testing and field trials.
* Perform RSSI, SNR, BER, packet\-loss and latency measurements.
* Use RF test equipment for troubleshooting and validation.
* Prepare RF test procedures and technical reports.


 Required Technical Skills
 
 Candidates should have practical knowledge of:
 


* RF communication systems
* RF link budget
* FHSS
* FSK / GFSK / PSK / QAM / OFDM
* SDR
* RF transceivers
* RF amplifiers
* Filters and RF front\-end design
* Antenna fundamentals
* Telemetry systems
* Long\-range data links
* UART / SPI / CAN / Ethernet
* TCP/IP and UDP
* Embedded communication interfaces
* RF spectrum analysis
* Signal integrity
* RF interference and coexistence


 Preferred Skills
 
 Strong advantage if the candidate has experience in:
 


* **GNU Radio**
* **MATLAB / Simulink**
* **C/C\+\+ / Python**
* USRP / ADALM\-Pluto / LimeSDR
* FHSS implementation
* Mesh networking
* MANET
* Swarm communication
* Anti\-jamming communication
* SDR\-based waveform development
* AES encryption
* GNSS\-denied communication environments
* SATCOM integration
* Defence communication systems
* RF spectrum monitoring
* Direction finding / RF sensing


 RF Test Equipment Experience
 
 Candidate should preferably have hands\-on experience with equipment such as:
 


* Spectrum Analyzer
* Vector Network Analyzer (VNA)
* Signal Generator
* RF Power Meter
* Oscilloscope
* Antenna Analyzer
* RF Attenuators / Couplers
* RF Power Amplifier testing equipment


 Education
 
**Required:** 



* B.Tech / M.Tech in Electronics \& Communication, Electronics, RF/Microwave Engineering, Telecommunications or related field.



**Preferred:** 



* M.Tech / specialization in RF \& Microwave, Wireless Communication, Communication Systems or SDR.

title: Senior Technology Lead
description:
**Senior Technology Lead – Product, Platform \& Infrastructure** 




**Experience:** 
 5–9 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram / Delhi NCR
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Company:** 
 KonProzTech Private Limited
 



**Compensation:** 
 Competitive fixed compensation \+ performance\-linked growth. ESOP participation will be considered after completion of 1 year, based on performance, ownership and contribution.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





**KonProzTech Private Limited is the parent company that is building various products in the domain of tax, finance, consulting and compliance areas.** 




**VIDUR is our 1st flagship product that is today live in 170\+ cities with 11,000\+ users growing with 30% MoM.** 




**We recently also launched VMUS, AI native consulting tech platform for boutique consulting for India Inc., MSME and startups.** 




**KonProz has built enterprise grade AI Agents for clients like Nirmal Bang, NexEdge capital in the domain of Insurance and Wealth sector.** 




**We are looking for a Senior Technology Lead who can take end\-to\-end ownership of our technology — products, infrastructure, engineering team, scalability, security and technical decision\-making.** 




**This is not a role where you will only manage developers or attend sprint meetings.** 




**We need someone who can look at the complete technology ecosystem, understand what can go wrong before it goes wrong, step into difficult situations when required and make sure the technology team keeps moving.** 




**You will work closely with the founders and will gradually become the key technology owner across VIDUR’s products and enterprise solutions.** 




  





**What You Will Own Product \& Technology** 



* Take overall technology ownership across VIDUR’s web, mobile, AI and enterprise products.
* Understand the architecture and dependencies across existing products.
* Work closely with product, business and founders to convert business requirements into practical technology execution.
* Review architecture and make decisions around scalability, reliability and performance.
* Evaluate new technologies, AI models, tools and infrastructure where they can improve the product.







**Infrastructure \& Reliability** 



* Own cloud infrastructure, deployment architecture, databases, APIs, monitoring and system reliability.
* Identify infrastructure risks before they turn into production issues.
* Build proper monitoring, alerts, backups, redundancy and recovery processes.
* Handle critical production issues and exception scenarios with the team.
* Improve system performance, scalability and infrastructure costs as the business grows.
* **Engineering Team**
* **Understand the technical capability required for each product and build the right engineering team accordingly.**
* **Allocate developers and technical resources based on product priorities.**
* **Conduct technical interviews and help us hire strong engineers.**
* **Mentor developers and improve engineering standards across the team.**
* **Identify capability gaps, performance issues and dependency risks early.**
* **Build a culture where engineers take ownership instead of waiting for instructions.**
* **Engineering Processes**
* **Establish strong standards around code quality, code reviews, documentation, testing and releases.**
* **Ensure that products are being built with long\-term maintainability in mind.**
* **Create clear development, deployment and incident\-management processes.**
* **Maintain visibility over technical debt and make sure critical issues do not keep getting postponed.**
* **Challenge technical decisions when there is a better or more scalable approach. Risk \& Problem Solving**
* **A major part of this role is seeing problems early. We expect you to:**
* **Identify technology red flags before they become business problems.**
* **Think through failure and exception scenarios while building products.**
* Ask “what happens if this fails?” before something goes live.
* Take ownership during production incidents instead of passing responsibility between teams.
* Understand root causes rather than applying temporary fixes.
* Balance speed of execution with stability and long\-term architecture.
* **Enterprise \& Leadership Exposure**
* **As VIDUR grows, you will also represent the technology function externally. You should be comfortable:**
* **Joining technical discussions with enterprise clients.**
* **Understanding enterprise requirements around integrations, APIs, security, infrastructure and**
* **data.**
* **Explaining our technology architecture in simple business language.**
* **Participating in technology discussions with investors and potential strategic partners.**
* **Responding confidently to technical due\-diligence questions.**
* **Working with founders on technology roadmap, product roadmap and future team requirements.**
* **You do not need to be a salesperson, but you should be able to represent the technology behind VIDUR confidently.**
* **What We Are Looking For**
* **We are looking for someone with 5–9 years of strong technology experience, preferably involving SaaS, AI products, fintech, tax\-tech, consulting\-tech enterprise software or high\-scale B2B platforms.**



  





**You should have:** 



* **Strong understanding of modern web application architecture.**
* **Good understanding of backend systems, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.**
* **Experience working with AWS / Azure / GCP or similar cloud environments.**
* **Understanding of system scalability, security, monitoring and reliability.**
* **Experience managing or mentoring developers.**
* **Ability to review architecture and code even if you are not coding every feature yourself.**
* **Experience handling production systems and real\-world failures.**
* Ability to conduct technical interviews and evaluate engineering talent (How has lifecycle
* changed from SDLC to ADLC).
* Strong communication skills for discussions with founders, investors and enterprise clients.
* Experience working with AI/LLMs, RAG, vector databases, document processing or AI\-native products would be a strong advantage.
* More Important Than the Tech Stack
* We care significantly about how you think. We want someone who:
* Thinks like an owner aka family;
* Takes responsibility when something breaks.
* Challenges assumptions instead of blindly executing requirements.
* Can operate with ambiguity.
* Is comfortable making decisions.
* Flags risks early, even when nobody has asked about them.
* Can go deep into a technical issue when required.
* Understands both technology and its business impact.
* Is willing to take on difficult problems.
* Can build systems and teams, not just features.
* If your first question when something goes wrong is “Who is responsible for this?”, this may not be the right role.
* If your first question is “What happened, how do we fix it, and how do we ensure it does not happen again?”, we would like to speak with you.
* What Success Looks Like
* Within the first year, we would expect you to:
* Have a strong understanding of the complete VIDUR technology architecture.
* Reduce critical production and infrastructure risks.
* Create better visibility over system performance and reliability.
* Build stronger engineering processes.
* Identify and close important skill gaps within the technology team.
* Improve the quality and speed of product releases.
* Create a scalable technical roadmap for future VIDUR products.
* Become the go\-to technology person for founders, enterprise clients and the engineering team.



  





**Why Join VIDUR** 



* **This role gives you the opportunity to take genuine technology ownership without being restricted to one engineering function.**
* **You will work directly with the founders, influence product and architecture decisions, participate in enterprise and investor discussions, build the engineering organization and help shape the next phase of VIDUR.**
* **For someone who demonstrates strong ownership and long\-term commitment, ESOP participation may be explored after completion of 1 year.**
* **This is a role for someone who wants to build — not just manage.**

**About The Role**

You will assist in firewall administration, load balancer operations, VPN support, network security monitoring, incident management, and service delivery activities while developing a strong foundation in network security technologies and best practices.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**

Assist with firewall policy reviews, access requests, rule analysis, and configuration validation. Monitor firewall logs and security events to identify network security issues and potential threats.

title: Engineer II - Information Engineer
description:
**About AlphaSense**
 The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision\-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.
   

  

 The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI\-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S\&P 500\. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!
   

  

**About The Team**
 The role of Engineer II, Information Engineering is responsible for designing, building, and operating scalable enterprise platforms that power internal teams across the organization. This role approaches technology challenges with an engineering mindset \- developing automated, reliable, and secure solutions that reduce manual work and enable teams to operate efficiently at scale.
   

  

 Our mission is to design, build, and operate secure, scalable IT platforms and identity services that power the company. We leverage engineering, automation, and deep systems expertise to reduce operational overhead, increase reliability, and support long\-term organizational growth.
   

  

 This engineer will focus on identity and access management, enterprise systems engineering, enterprise security, and automation\-driven platform development, while supporting complex technical initiatives across the organization. The role requires strong technical expertise, architectural thinking, and the ability to translate business needs into scalable engineering solutions.
   

  

 Working closely with cross\-functional teams, the engineer will help shape the technical direction of enterprise systems while promoting best practices in automation, infrastructure management, and system reliability. This role provides an opportunity to directly impact the productivity, security, and scalability of the company as we continue to grow.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of experience and certifications.
* Strong programming and scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, and Bash.
* Experience integrating systems using RESTful APIs, authentication frameworks such as OAuth, and common data formats such as JSON and YAML.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems (Git) to manage infrastructure, automation, and configuration changes.
* Experience designing and maintaining system integrations and automation using APIs and event\-driven workflows.
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, troubleshooting, and system performance optimization.
* Experience in identity and access management platforms, particularly Okta and Okta Workflows, and experience designing secure identity architectures.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities with a structured and analytical approach to designing technical solutions.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**What You’ll Do**
* Design and build automation\-driven solutions and system integrations that reduce manual operational work and improve reliability across enterprise systems.
* Develop and maintain internal platforms and services that support identity management, enterprise applications, and secure access to company resources.
* Design, implement, and support networking and secure access technologies, including Zero Trust Network Access and identity\-aware access controls.
* Apply engineering best practices such as infrastructure as code, version control, testing, and CI/CD to enterprise systems and automation workflows.
* Define and maintain architecture standards, design principles, and technical guidelines to ensure a consistent and scalable enterprise platform.
* Collaborate with internal teams to understand business needs and translate them into secure, scalable engineering solutions.
* Partner with Security and Compliance teams to support initiatives such as vulnerability management, patching, and incident response.
* Contribute to technical planning and implementation of complex cross\-functional technology initiatives.
* Maintain documentation for system designs, integrations, and automation workflows to support long\-term maintainability.
* Provide technical mentorship and guidance to team members while promoting a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement.
* Stay informed on emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, security, and scalability.


**Nice To Have**
 Experience with the following technologies and concepts is considered a strong plus:
   

  

* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools and automation, including using LLMs or AI APIs to build internal tooling, improve workflows, or enhance operational efficiency
* AWS fundamentals and cloud\-native service architecture
* Experience working with endpoint management platforms, enterprise security tools and APIs, such as Kandji, Microsoft Intune, CrowdStrike, or Cloudflare
* Deeper understanding of enterprise networking concepts
* Familiarity with SQL or lightweight data querying
* Experience with message queues or event\-driven automation architectures.

title: Senior Manager, Incident & Change Management (ITIL Expertise + Experience in Network, Infra, Data Centre & Application-Support is a Must)
description:
**Overview**
 WELCOME TO SITA
   

  

 At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
   

  

 You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward\-we're proud to be recognized as a
 **Great Place to Work** 
 ® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
   

  

 Are you ready to love your job?
   

  

 The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
   

  

**About The Role \& Team**
 As Senior Manager, Incident \& Change Management within Digital Customer Operations (DCO), you will lead a global team of Incident and Change Managers responsible for protecting service continuity, governing operational change, and restoring critical services with speed and control. You will combine advanced, hands\-on ITIL expertise with strong operational leadership across network, infrastructure, data centre and application\-support environments. The role is a senior escalation point for complex regional and global services, engaging executives, customers and technical leaders during high\-impact incidents and major changes. You will drive continuous improvement and digitalization, strengthen customer outcomes, and build a high\-performing team aligned with DCO priorities.
   

  

* As per SITA Career Framework the title will be Senior Manager, Service Operations


**What You’ll Do**
 Incident Management
   

  

* Lead and govern the end\-to\-end Incident Management process, ensuring the rapid restoration of critical services while minimizing business and customer impact.
* Act as the senior escalation point for high\-severity incidents, coordinating technical, operational, and business teams to drive timely resolution.
* Lead crisis management activities during service disruptions, providing clear communication and regular updates to executives, customers, and key stakeholders.
* Drive incident response governance, ensuring adherence to ITIL best practices, escalation procedures, and operational controls.
* Monitor and improve incident management KPIs, including service availability, resolution times, service restoration metrics, and customer impact.
* Lead post\-incident reviews and root cause analysis to identify corrective actions and prevent recurrence.
* Collaborate with Network, Infrastructure, Data Center, Application Support, and Service Operations teams to strengthen service resilience and operational stability.
* Provide leadership during executive\-level escalations, effectively managing communications with senior management and strategic customers.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance incident response effectiveness, operational performance, and customer experience.


**Change Management**
* Lead and govern the end\-to\-end Change Management process, ensuring all infrastructure, network, application, and service changes are implemented in a controlled and risk\-managed manner.
* Establish and maintain Change Management policies, standards, and governance frameworks in alignment with ITIL best practices.
* Chair Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings, evaluating change risks, business impacts, dependencies, and implementation readiness.
* Ensure changes are assessed, approved, tested, and deployed with minimal disruption to business operations and customer services.
* Monitor change effectiveness through KPIs and reporting, including change success rates, failed changes, emergency changes, and change\-related incidents.
* Partner with operational, engineering, and business teams to balance service stability, operational resilience, and business agility.
* Act as the senior escalation point for high\-risk or business\-critical changes, providing clear communication and decision\-making support to senior stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance change governance, reduce operational risk, and improve service reliability across complex enterprise environments.
* Lead post\-implementation reviews and ensure lessons learned are incorporated into future change planning and execution.


**Qualifications**
**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS**
* Continuous Improvement \& Digitalization: Demonstrated ability to use incident, change, SLA and KPI insights to simplify workflows, strengthen controls, automate repeatable activities and improve operational performance.
* Customer\-Centric Thinking: Proven ability to make service decisions based on customer impact, business criticality and transparent communication, while balancing restoration speed, risk and long\-term service quality.
* Self \& Business Leadership: Strong executive presence, judgement and accountability, with the ability to remain composed during crises, set direction, influence decisions and lead teams through ambiguity and operational pressure.
* Advanced hands\-on expertise in ITIL Service Management, with deep experience across Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management, and Service Operations governance.
* Extensive experience leading large\-scale operational environments, ensuring service stability, resilience, and continuous operational excellence.
* Strong leadership, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive alignment and decision\-making across cross\-functional and geographically dispersed teams.
* Proven capability in Major Incident and Crisis Management, including leading the response to critical service disruptions and coordinating recovery efforts within complex enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated experience defining, monitoring, and improving Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) to drive operational performance and customer satisfaction.
* Broad technical understanding of enterprise IT environments, including Network Operations, Infrastructure Services, Data Center Operations, and Application Support, enabling effective decision\-making during service\-impacting events.
* Experience acting as the senior escalation point for high\-priority service issues, effectively managing communications and resolutions involving executive leadership, strategic customers, and business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with the ability to assess operational risks, identify improvement opportunities, and drive sustainable service enhancements.
* Proven track record of leading service management teams and fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Experience managing major incidents and enterprise change across large customer accounts, third\-party suppliers and geographically distributed operations.
* This role requires approximately 20% travel to support regional operations, strategic customers, and key service\-management activities.
* At least 10 years of experience in incident management, change management experience, escalation manager and crisis management, or a related discipline.
* Bachelor's degree in, IT, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.


**What We Offer**
 We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
   

  

 🏡
 **Flex Week:** 
 Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)
   

  

 ⏰
 **Flex Day:** 
 Make your workday suit your life and plans.
   

  

 🌎
 **Flex\-Location:** 
 Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
   

  

 🌿
 **Employee Wellbeing:** 
 We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health \- a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
   

  

 🚀
 **Professional Development:** 
 At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world\-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From
 **LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,** 
 and
 **Airport Council International** 
 \-available to all employees\-to specialized solutions like
 **Pluralsight** 
 for technology upskilling,
 **Harvard Business Publishing** 
 for people leadership,
 **Stanford** 
 for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.
   

  

 🙌
 **Competitive Benefits:** 
 Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.
   

  

*SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self\-identify in the application process.*

title: Network Engineer
description:
**\# Senior Network Engineer – Cloud Platform Engineering** 




  





**\*\*Location:\*\* Noida – Sector 62** 




**\*\*Experience:\*\* 8\+ Years** 




**\*\*Notice Period:\*\* 15 Days to 1 Month** 




**\*\*Work Mode:\*\* In\-office, 5 Days a Week** 




**\*\*Shift:\*\* 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM** 




**\*\*WFH:\*\* Eligible after 7:00 PM daily** 




**\*\*Interview Process:\*\* 3 Virtual Rounds** 




  





**\*Budget:\* Up to 30 LPA** 




  





**\#\# About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer to join the Cloud Platform Engineering team and help design, build, automate, secure, and operate cloud, corporate, server, and data center infrastructure.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience across enterprise networking, cloud networking, data center infrastructure, network security, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and production support.
 



  





**\#\# Key Responsibilities** 




  





**\#\#\# 1\. Cloud Network Engineering** 




  





 \* Design and maintain cloud network architectures.
 



 \* Manage VPCs, subnets, route tables, Internet/NAT gateways, Transit Gateway, VPC Peering, private connectivity, load balancers, DNS, and network security controls.
 



 \* Support multi\-account, multi\-region, and multi\-cloud network architectures.
 



 \* Design highly available and resilient network infrastructure.
 



 \* Support cloud landing zones and Cloud Foundation initiatives.
 



  





**\#\#\# 2\. Enterprise \& Corporate Network** 




  





 \* Design, implement, manage, and troubleshoot corporate network infrastructure.
 



 \* Manage LAN/WAN, VLANs, routing, switching, wireless, VPNs, firewalls, proxies, and network access controls.
 



 \* Establish secure connectivity between corporate networks and cloud environments.
 



 \* Support remote\-access and site\-to\-site VPN solutions.
 



 \* Monitor network availability, performance, capacity, and utilization.
 



 \* Troubleshoot complex connectivity issues.
 



 \* Participate in network lifecycle management and technology refresh initiatives.
 



  





**\#\#\# 3\. Server Infrastructure Management** 




  





 \* Support network and infrastructure requirements for physical and virtual server environments.
 



 \* Support Linux and Windows server connectivity.
 



 \* Troubleshoot server connectivity, DNS, routing, firewall, load\-balancing, and certificate\-related issues.
 



 \* Support server provisioning and decommissioning activities.
 



 \* Ensure network segmentation and security controls for server environments.
 



 \* Support connectivity between physical servers, virtual environments, storage platforms, and cloud infrastructure.
 



  





**\#\#\# 4\. Multi\-Cloud Connectivity** 




  





 \* Design and maintain connectivity across corporate networks, data centers, cloud environments, and remote locations.
 



 \* Support connectivity across AWS, GCP, and OCI.
 



 \* Manage AWS Direct Connect, AWS Site\-to\-Site VPN, AWS Transit Gateway, GCP Cloud Interconnect, GCP Cloud VPN, OCI FastConnect, and OCI VPN.
 



 \* Troubleshoot end\-to\-end connectivity across corporate, data center, and cloud environments.
 



 \* Design resilient cross\-cloud network architectures.
 



 \* Support migration of legacy infrastructure into cloud environments.
 



  





**\#\#\# 5\. Network Architecture** 




  





 \* Develop network architecture and design documentation.
 



 \* Establish reference architectures and reusable network patterns.
 



 \* Participate in architecture reviews and technical design discussions.
 



 \* Design network segmentation and IP addressing strategies.
 



 \* Establish standards for routing, connectivity, DNS, network security, and traffic management.
 



 \* Evaluate networking technologies and recommend scalable solutions.
 



  





**\#\#\# 6\. Network Security** 




  





 \* Implement secure\-by\-default cloud and enterprise network architectures.
 



 \* Manage Security Groups, Network ACLs, cloud firewalls, WAFs, firewall policies, network segmentation, and private endpoints.
 



 \* Partner with Security teams on network security standards.
 



 \* Support security reviews and vulnerability remediation.
 



 \* Implement least\-privilege network access.
 



 \* Support TLS/SSL, certificates, encryption, and secure network communication.
 



 \* Support Zero Trust network architecture initiatives.
 



  





**\#\#\# 7\. Infrastructure as Code \& Network Automation** 




  





 \* Develop and maintain network infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
 



 \* Build reusable Terraform modules.
 



 \* Automate network provisioning, configuration, validation, and operational tasks.
 



 \* Develop automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar technologies.
 



 \* Implement automated network configuration and compliance checks.
 



 \* Participate in CI/CD processes for infrastructure changes.
 



 \* Develop automated validation and testing for network infrastructure changes.
 



  





**\#\#\# 8\. Network Monitoring \& Observability** 




  





 \* Implement monitoring and observability for cloud, corporate, and data center networks.
 



 \* Monitor network latency, throughput, packet loss, connectivity, DNS performance, load balancer health, VPN connectivity, and network utilization.
 



 \* Use Datadog, CloudWatch, network telemetry, and flow logs.
 



 \* Develop proactive alerts and operational dashboards.
 



 \* Analyze network telemetry and logs to identify performance and security issues.
 



  





**\#\#\# 9\. Production Support \& Incident Management** 




  





 \* Provide Level 3 support for complex network, server connectivity, data center, and cloud infrastructure issues.
 



 \* Participate in production incident response and on\-call/shift rotations.

* Strong understanding of security principles, including IDS/IPS, VPN (IPsec, SSL), encryption protocols, and endpoint security.

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with network automation tools, scripting languages such as Python and Ansible, and AI agents is a plus.
* Knowledge of cloud networking concepts and hybrid cloud architectures, including AWS and Azure.
* Ability to lead and mentor security network engineers, provide technical guidance, and foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with excellent attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive initiatives effectively.

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting\-edge of computer technology.

As a Datacenter Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software. You'll also take on the installation of components such as networks, routers and switches. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting\-edge of computer technology.

title: Sr Professional Services Consultant (PSC)
description:

We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

**Job Description**
 Your Career As a Professional Services Consultant, you will be a pivotal technical expert, spearheading the successful deployment and initial configuration of our Prisma Access Browser (PAB) solution for customers. This is a highly impactful, hands\-on role where you will directly translate customer security requirements into a fully operational and optimized cloud\-delivered browser security solution. Working closely with customers, solution consultants, and project managers, you will implement PAB according to best practices and customer\-specific needs. Beyond deployment, you will be a proactive driver, navigating complex environments, anticipating roadblocks, and accelerating our customers' journey to a Zero Trust architecture. You will solidify customer partnerships with Palo Alto Networks by ensuring they successfully adopt and maximize the value of PAB. If you thrive on technical challenges, leading complex deployments, and being the face of strategic, results\-driven implementation, this is your next career move. Your Impact Proactively Drive Technical Deployment: Execute the complete technical lifecycle of PAB implementation, including secure tenant setup and complex Identity Provider (IdP) integrations. Take ownership of the deployment timeline, proactively managing and overcoming any customer hesitations or delays to ensure rapid time\-to\-value Translate Strategy to Security Policy: Convert customer business and security designs into practical, effective PAB configurations, focusing on access controls, data loss prevention (DLP) rules, and web security policies Drive Adoption: Guide customers through the secure and large\-scale deployment of the PAB extension/client to end\-user devices using various enterprise deployment methods (e.g., GPO, MDM) Be a Proactive Technical Advisor: Serve as the go\-to expert for PAB best practices, advanced feature utilization, and performance tuning, actively monitoring environments to pre\-emptively identify, recommend, and resolve potential issues or areas for security posture improvement Resolve Complex Escalations: Act as the primary technical escalation point, performing deep\-dive root cause analysis and coordinating across Support, Engineering, and Product teams for timely resolution Document and Transfer Knowledge: Create high\-quality, customer\-specific "as\-built" documentation and deliver comprehensive operational training and knowledge transfer to customer administrators Advocate for the Customer: Capture and translate valuable field feedback into actionable feature requests, serving as a critical internal voice for product improvement and development Maintain expert\-level understanding of Prisma Access Browser: Stay updated on latest product releases, security trends, and industry best practices. Actively participate in relevant training and certification programs to maintain technical proficiency
   

  

**Qualifications (Additional Job Description)**
 Your Experience 8\+ years of experience required in a hands\-on, technical, customer\-facing role such as Professional Services Consultant, Technical Account Manager, or Senior Sales Engineer Proven track record of proactive engagement; the ability to take initiative to push customers toward successful deployment, manage project risks, and navigate organizational challenges or pushback to maintain project velocity Expert\-level knowledge of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S) and enterprise security principles (Zero Trust, SASE, Firewall, Proxy, VPN) Demonstrated ability to independently lead and execute complex technical projects in customer environments, driving deployment to successful completion Advanced analytical and troubleshooting skills with a methodical approach to identifying, diagnosing, and resolving technical issues (Root Cause Analysis) Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a proven ability to convey complex security topics to diverse technical and non\-technical stakeholders Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) and authentication protocols, specifically integrating solutions with IdPs like Azure AD or Okta using SAML 2\.0 Familiarity with cloud and SaaS security architecture and the challenges associated with securing modern applications and browsers Knowledge of Prisma Access deployment, architecture, and traffic flows These skills are desired and will be prioritized, accelerating time\-to\-value in the role: Basic knowledge of enterprise tools for large\-scale device deployment (e.g., Microsoft Intune, Jamf, SCCM) Industry certifications such as Palo Alto Networks (PCNSA, PCNSE), CISSP, or cloud\-specific security certifications Basic scripting ability (e.g., PowerShell, Python) for automation or data manipulation
   

  

**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com .
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

title: Senior Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure
description:
**Overview**
 Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+ employees and \~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. **AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
 Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation
   

  

 Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

***Recruitment Scam Notice:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “* 
*name@cvent.com* 
*” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*
*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.*
*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.* 
*https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud* 
*.*
 As a member of
 **Cloud Infrastructure team** 
 , you will design, build, and operate the AWS foundation that underpins Cvent’s products. You will own complex infrastructure services end\-to\-end, drive automation\-first practices, and help evolve our “paved road” for engineers building on AWS.
   

  

 A key focus for this role is to
 **apply AI/ML and AI agents to Cloud Infrastructure operations** 
 – using single and multi‑agent systems and orchestration frameworks to automate diagnostics, runbooks, and workflows while maintaining strong guardrails around security, reliability, and cost.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with Cloud Infrastructure peers, SREs, Security Engineering, and product teams across geographies.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
**Cloud Infrastructure Engineering (AWS)**
* Design, implement, and operate highly available, secure, and scalable AWS infrastructure (e.g., VPC, Transit Gateway, EC2, Load Balancing, S3, EBS/EFS/FSx, Route 53, IAM, KMS, Backup).
* Build and maintain infrastructure\-as\-code using tools such as AWS CDK / CloudFormation, enforcing standards, guardrails, and reusable patterns.
* Develop automation and tooling (primarily in Python/TypeScript) to remove repetitive operational work (provisioning, patching, configuration, cleanup, compliance checks, reporting).
* Contribute to and sometimes lead design reviews, architecture discussions, and RFCs for new or evolving infrastructure services.
* Partner with Security and Compliance to meet security, audit, and regulatory requirements across accounts and regions.


**AI Agents, Orchestration \& Multi‑Agent Systems**
* Identify high‑value Cloud Infra workflows (e.g., incident triage, change impact analysis, runbook execution, capacity/cost recommendations) that can be automated using AI agents.
* Design and implement agentic workflows (single and multi‑agent) using modern AI orchestration patterns and frameworks (e.g., tool‑calling, planners, evaluators, guardrails).
* Integrate agents with existing cloud APIs, observability tools, ticketing systems, and runbooks to provide end‑to‑end, human\-in\-the\-loop automation.
* Define and enforce safety, security, and approval guardrails for AI‑driven actions (RBAC, policy checks, dry‑runs, explicit approvals, audit logging).
* Measure and communicate impact of AI automation (MTTR reduction, hours saved, error reduction, cost optimization, improved engineer experience).


**Reliability, Operations \& On‑Call**
* Own the reliability and performance of services you build – from design through deployment and production operations.
* Implement and tune monitoring, logging, alerting, and SLO/SLA dashboards for Cloud Infra services (Datadog/Splunk/CloudWatch or similar).
* Participate in the on‑call rotation, lead troubleshooting for complex AWS infrastructure incidents, and drive post‑incident reviews and preventative improvements.
* Proactively identify technical debt and reliability risks in infrastructure and drive remediation plans.


**Collaboration, Mentoring \& Best Practices**
* Act as a technical mentor to Engineer I/II teammates on AWS fundamentals, automation patterns, and AI‑driven operations.
* Help define and evolve paved road standards for AWS infrastructure, automation, and AI agent usage across Cloud Infrastructure.
* Contribute to runbooks, design docs, knowledge base articles, and internal training sessions, including AI and automation best practices


**Required Qualifications**
**Here's What You Need:**
* 3–6 years of hands\-on‑ experience in Cloud / Infrastructure Engineering, or similar roles, with strong focus on AWS.
* Deep understanding of core AWS services: VPC \& networking (subnets, routing, TGW, VPN/Direct Connect, security groups, NACLs), EC2, Auto Scaling, Load Balancing, S3, EBS/EFS/FSx, Route 53, IAM, KMS, CloudWatch/CloudTrail, and Backup.
* Strong experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code (AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform) and Git\-based workflows (branching, PR reviews, CI/CD).
* Solid programming skills in at least one language commonly used for infra\-automation, such as Python or TypeScript/Node.js.
* Proven track record designing and operating production\-grade, multi‑account/multi‑region AWS environments with a focus on security, reliability, and cost.
* Experience implementing observability for infrastructure services (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, dashboards).
* Demonstrated ability to own complex projects end\-to\-end: requirements, design, implementation, rollout, and post‑launch improvements.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills; comfortable working with distributed teams and multiple stakeholders (SRE, Security, product engineering, leadership).


**AI / Agentic Skills – Required**
* Practical experience building or integrating LLM\-based solutions (e.g., using OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure/OpenAI\-compatible, or similar APIs).
* Hands\-on experience with at least one of:
+ AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph\-style, CrewAI\-like, or custom agent patterns), or
+ Orchestrating multi\-step AI workflows using tools, function calling, or custom planners.

* Ability to translate infra problems into agentic workflows (e.g., “given alerts \+ context, generate and execute an actionable runbook; escalate with a summarized context if confidence is low”).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), and techniques to constrain and evaluate AI outputs in production.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience in a large\-scale SaaS or multi‑tenant environment.
* Exposure to cost optimization / FinOps in AWS (right‑sizing, storage optimization, data transfer analysis, automated cleanup).
* Experience with security engineering concepts such as least‑privilege IAM design, KMS usage patterns, and network security controls.
* Experience integrating AI agents with ticketing and workflow platforms (Jira/ServiceNow, Slack/MS Teams bots, internal tools).
* AWS certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional, Security – Specialty, or Advanced Networking) or equivalent experience.


**Success in This Role**
**In Your First 12–18 Months, Success Looks Like**
* You are a go‑to engineer for complex AWS infrastructure questions in your domain.
* You have delivered at least one or two production AI‑agent workflows that measurably improve Cloud Infra operations (e.g., reduced MTTR, reduced manual toil, or better cost visibility).
* Your infrastructure services are well‑documented, observable, and resilient, with clear runbooks and strong hand‑offs to on‑call engineers.
* You are actively mentoring Engineer I/II teammates and influencing our standards for AWS, automation, and responsible AI usage.


**Cloud Infrastructure**
* Design, develop, and troubleshoot automation jobs for complex workflows across AWS accounts and regions.
* Create and assign Jira tasks to drive progress with clear ownership and follow‑through.
* Create and maintain wiki documentation / README files for workflows, procedures, and tooling enhancements.
* Identify gaps in runbook coverage and author new runbooks that enable repeatable, reliable operations.
* Display mastery of service(s) within a single pillar (e.g., Networking, Compute, Storage, Security, Orchestration).
* Demonstrate competency across multiple pillars, understanding how services interact end‑to‑end.
* Collaborate effectively across CloudOps, SRE, Security, Product Engineering, and other technology teams.


**Cvent Behavioral Competencies**
* Anticipates customer needs and delivers services beyond expectations, with a strong internal customer mindset.
* Uses customer insights and data to influence and guide new infrastructure and automation offerings.
* Serves as a strategic partner to build, grow, and maintain long‑term, sustainable, and profitable relationships.


**CloudOps Core Competencies**
* Troubleshoot high‑complexity issues, including multi‑service and multi‑region incidents.
* Coordinate and troubleshoot issues involving 3rd‑party vendors, assisting in vendor relationship management.
* Provide guidance and mentoring to junior engineers on troubleshooting, design, and best practices.
* Share knowledge broadly (e.g., lunch‑and‑learns, mentoring, internal training, documentation).
* Perform as an individual contributor on high‑complexity tasks, owning them end‑to‑end.
* Act as primary point of contact for internal and cross‑tech (CTC) level projects in your domain.
* Help allocate work across individual contributors and identify when additional support is needed.
* Recognize when project timelines are at risk and partner with leadership to adjust scope or approach.
* Communicates progress, risks, and needs clearly to management and stakeholders.
* Contribute to an inclusive, collaborative, and respectful organizational culture.


 If you’re passionate about
 **Cloud Infrastructure** 
 , enjoy
 **building automation and tools** 
 , and are excited about applying
 **AI agents and orchestration to real‑world infrastructure problems** 
 , we’d love to talk to you.

* About iDream Education


**Vision:** 
 Unlimited Learning. Unlimited Growth. For Everyone.
   

  

**Belief:** 
 We believe that access to learning and growth is a fundamental right, and that learning in its truest sense is the joyful unfolding of a being's fullest potential — in all dimensions of life.
   

  

**Mission:** 
 To deliver solutions and experiences that facilitate access to learning and growth for everyone, irrespective of their languages, geographies, abilities, curricula, age groups, learning styles, and socio\-economic status.
   

  

**Education**
 iPrep by iDream Education is a Learning Platform that runs both offline \& online, is bilingual and works on all major hardware devices and operating systems. iPrep delivers curriculum\-aligned digital learning for classes 1st to 12th in English, Hindi, and Regional language mediums for universal reach and learning use as:

 **Learn Unlimited**
